mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in industrial production exceeds 3%, it signals strong demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as corporations ramp up production to meet demand.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 50% of 20-day windows following a 3%+ YoY rise in IP.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals an improving labor market and strengthening consumer demand, which will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next month.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of 20-day windows following a 0.5pp+ 3mo drop in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 60-day windows when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing PMI is above 55 and the industrial production index is rising month-over-month, it signals strong manufacturing activity that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of 60-day windows when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4% and payroll employment is rising by more than 200,000 jobs per month, it signals a very tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 20-day windows when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index is rising by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate is above 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both conditions are met.
